summary.intent: Complete phase 19.1 of a monorepo extraction, verifying and fixing the SDK integration checkpoint (plan 19.1-05) that rewires the web app's React hooks and Zustand stores to use the new CipherBoxClient SDK instead of calling service functions directly.
summary.outcome: 9/10 SDK operations verified working via Playwright (create/rename folder, upload, download, text edit, rename file, move file via dialog and DnD, delete file). Delete-to-bin remains broken due to SDK bin state not loading from the old service's IPNS record. Multiple atomic bug fixes committed.

repo: CipherBox is a pnpm monorepo with packages: @cipherbox/crypto, @cipherbox/core, @cipherbox/sdk-core, @cipherbox/sdk, @cipherbox/api-client. Build order matters — sdk-core must build before sdk.

The orval-generated @cipherbox/api-client requires setApiClientConfig() to be called at runtime before any generated functions work — this is a silent failure (throws 'API client not configured') that was never wired up in the web app.
A dual-path architecture where SDK handles folder CRUD but old services handle file upload causes irreconcilable IPNS sequence number conflicts — both write to the same IPNS records independently.
The old service bin initialization (initializeBin) must complete before SDK loadBin() is called, otherwise SDK can't resolve the bin IPNS record. Initialization order matters.
Pre-existing DTS circular dependency between @cipherbox/core and @cipherbox/crypto causes pnpm -r run build to fail, but per-package builds succeed.
The web app's upload toolbar button renders as '+folder', not 'New Folder' — existing E2E selectors were stale.
E2E tests use web3auth OTP flow; the API logs DEV OTPs to stdout under the pattern 'DEV OTP for <email>'.
The API has a test-login secret (TEST_LOGIN_SECRET env var) enabling passwordless auth for integration tests.

code.finding: setApiClientConfig() was never called during SDK initialization, silently breaking all @cipherbox/api-client generated functions (IPNS publish, resolve, etc.). Fix: call it with the auth token after vault load, before initSdkClient.

ensureFolderRegistered was a problematic bridge that tried to sync store state into SDK state but repeatedly corrupted SDK's internal IPNS private key and sequence number. Root fix was eliminating dual-path writes; simplified to skip-if-SDK-has-it.

createFolder was returning ipnsName as the folder id, but the store expects a UUID (the FolderEntry child id). Fix: return the UUID from FolderEntry so the store can look up the folder correctly during navigation.
updateFolderMetadataAndPublish needed a 409 conflict retry: on conflict, re-resolve current IPNS sequence number and retry once. Without this, any stale seq number causes a permanent failure.

Was a two-step flow (upload.service encrypts+uploads, then useFileOperations creates per-file IPNS + registers FilePointer). Rewired to call client.uploadFile() which handles everything atomically, eliminating dual-path IPNS conflicts.
Was using old file-metadata.service -> ipns.service chain for IPNS resolution, which resolves differently from SDK. Rewired to client.downloadFromIpns() which uses the same resolution path as upload.
Was calling old download service directly for file decryption, causing 'decryption failed'. Rewired to use SDK client download path.

Full SDK lifecycle integration test (create folder, upload, download+verify, rename file/folder, delete, check empty) using test-login secret. Tests must be in a single describe block due to shared state — interdependent operations can't be split into independent test cases.

workflow: Using random emails per E2E test run gives a clean vault each time, avoiding state pollution from previous runs.
Playwright MCP tools can drive a headed browser session for interactive debugging — useful when the user wants to observe without driving the UI themselves.
When debugging IPNS 409 conflicts, check which code paths are writing to the same IPNS record — dual writers are the root cause, not timing.
Vitest workspace package resolution works for SDK integration tests; Node.js direct execution cannot resolve workspace packages without additional tooling.
Atomic commits require restoring original files, applying only the specific change, committing, then applying the next change — cannot stage partial hunks of a rewritten file easily.

friction: E2E Playwright test setup repeatedly broke: wrong button selectors (+folder vs 'New Folder'), __dirname ESM incompatibility in .spec.ts files, workspace package resolution failures in Node.js.
Multiple rounds of ensureFolderRegistered fixes that each created new edge cases — the bridge approach was fundamentally flawed and should have been eliminated earlier.
Background task notifications for stale/earlier test runs kept arriving and required reading output files that were already processed.
User had to manually provide OTPs for manual verification before Playwright automation was set up.
The user had to explicitly instruct the assistant to stop asking for manual verification and drive Playwright autonomously.
Initial plan reset was required because the user was unhappy with prior implementation decisions — prior work was discarded.
409 IPNS conflicts recurred at multiple layers (upload, rename, folder create in E2E) requiring the retry logic to be added to sdk-core.
open_items: Delete-to-bin via SDK is broken — SDK loadBin() can't load the bin IPNS record created by the old initializeBin service. Needs investigation into why SDK's bin resolution differs from old service.
useFileDelete not refactored to SDK (noted as checkpoint deviation) — still on old service pattern.
Pre-existing DTS circular dependency between @cipherbox/core and @cipherbox/crypto breaks pnpm -r run build.
Deprecated folder/bin/share services (marked DEPRECATED in plan 19.1-05) are still in use for bin operations and file delete — need full removal once SDK covers those paths.
Debug test file tests/e2e/tests/sdk-debug.spec.ts was created during debugging — should be cleaned up or promoted to a proper regression suite.

Atomic commits for the remaining fixes (after setApiClientConfig) were started but not completed in the transcript — folder UUID fix, upload rewire, download rewire, and bin loadBin commits are pending.
